packages.label: שְׁכִינָה וְאֶרֶץ הָעֶלְיוֹנָה
packages.label_en: The Shekhinah and the Upper Earth
packages.reason: These two nodes share the essential nature of the divine indwelling presence — the Shekhinah. The Rebbe explicitly equates them: 'מִן הָאָרֶץ – הַיְנוּ אֶרֶץ הָעֶלְיוֹנָה, בְּחִינַת הַשְּׁכִינָה'. In kabbalistic terminology, אֶרֶץ הָעֶלְיוֹנָה (the upper earth / supernal earth) is a standard name for the sefirah of Malkhut, which is itself identified with the Shekhinah — the indwelling divine presence that receives the sparks (ניצוצות) fallen in the Breaking. Both nodes express the same single reality: the receptive, immanent dimension of divinity that is the locus of cosmic deficiency and repair. The teaching turns on the verse 'יִתַּמּוּ חַטָּאִים מִן הָאָרֶץ' — when one rejoices in God, the חטאים/חסרונות (deficiencies) are completed 'from' the Shekhinah, meaning the Shekhinah herself is made whole. The bechina ארץ העליונה = שכינה is the conceptual anchor of the entire Torah.
merge_notes: No merges performed — this Torah has exactly one bechina edge and one raw connected component of 2 nodes. The component is already its own coherent package.
שכינה is designated dominant node over ארץ העליונה because שכינה is the theologically primary concept; ארץ העליונה functions as the interpretive gloss on the verse's 'מִן הָאָרֶץ'.
